items.Sentence: The Discharger currently has an average daily discharge of 9,000 gpd, of domestic wastewater to a septic tank effluent pump (STEP) system for wastewater collection.
The community system consists of individual septic tanks with pump chambers and submersible pumps discharging to a dosing tank...
The community system consists of individual septic tanks with pump chambers and submersible pumps discharging to a dosing tank and then to one or both of two common leachfields...
Phase II (discharge > 33,000 gpd) purposes the installation of a recirculating sand filter (or equivalent) between the septic tanks and leachfields...

Phase III (discharge > 66,000 gpd) will involve the construction of an advanced secondary package treatment plant with sufficient effluent quality to be used as reclaimed water for possible golf course irrigation.
